key.description: What happened on the tap, as the tenant was shown it. On this endpoint use a `lock.*` value; see [Reporting a tap](https://docs.keepitsimplestorage.com/guides/white-label/quickstart#reporting-a-tap) for which one to send.

reason.description: Required when `key` is `lock.open_failure` or `lock.close_failure`, optional otherwise. On a failure, short text saying what went wrong. On an unconfirmed key, the cause token for that outcome; see [Reporting a tap](https://docs.keepitsimplestorage.com/guides/white-label/quickstart#reporting-a-tap).

happened_at.description: When the tap happened on the device (ISO 8601). Send it to backfill a tap recorded while offline.

app_version.description: Optional: your app's version, e.g. `2.4.0`. Up to 20 characters.

app_build.description: Optional: your app's build number. Up to 20 characters.

platform.description: Optional: `ios` or `android`. You can send it in the `X-Client-Platform` header instead.

error_code.description: Why the tap failed, as one of the server's snake_case error codes (see [Reporting a tap](https://docs.keepitsimplestorage.com/guides/white-label/quickstart#reporting-a-tap)). Any other value is accepted but stored as null.

first_error_code.description: The error code of the first failed attempt, when the tap took more than one. Same values as `error_code`.

duration_ms.description: Optional: how long the whole interaction took, in milliseconds, including any retries.

attempt_count.description: Optional: how many attempts the interaction took, counting the first.

nfc_antenna_profile.description: Optional. Leave it out unless KISS asks you to send it.

scanned_lock_serial.description: The lock the phone actually reached: `0x` followed by the lock SDK's `session.lockId`.

field_lost_after_start.description: `true` when the lock started the action and the phone moved away before it finished (the lock SDK's `fieldLostAfterStart` outcome). Send it with the successful key.

package.description: Optional: the name of the library that ran the tap, for diagnostics.

package_version.description: Optional: the version of that library.

client_now.description: Optional: the device's current time when it sends the log (ISO 8601), so KISS can spot a phone clock that is wrong.
